newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to issue bid spec for power selloff in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to issue bid spec for power selloff in Dec.

text.p: Brazil will publish a bid specification on Dec 15 that seeks advisers to draw up a plan to privatize power-generating firms Furnas and Eletrosul, said a National Development Bank (BNDES) spokesman.
The two companies, controlled by Eletrobras, are expected to be privatized late next year, he said.
Eletrobras' other two units, Eletronorte and Companhia Hidreletrica do Sao Francisco (Chesf), will be sold after they have completed ongoing expansion plans, he added.
Separately, British consulting firm Coopers & Lybrand is preparing a plan to assess the value of Eletrobras assets. The project is expected to be ready next month.
